content: In preparation for the Student Evaluation of Teaching (SET) for the Second Semester, students are required to access the AMIS SET module to verify whether their enrolled courses are correctly reflected.
title: AMIS Set Module Orientation

content: Enrollment for First Semester AY 2025-2026 opens July 1. Check your AMIS portal for assigned schedules. Late enrollees must secure permits from the College Secretary.
title: First Semester Enrollment Schedule

content: Free Wi-Fi upgrades in the Library and Student Plaza from June 15-20. Expect intermittent connectivity. Contact ITDC Helpdesk for assistance during maintenance.
title: Campus Wi-Fi Enhancement

content: Submit scholarship renewal applications to the Office of Student Affairs by June 30. Required documents: latest grades, certificate of registration, and proof of income.
title: Scholarship Renewal Deadline

content: Join the campus cleanup drive on June 21, 8 AM at the Freedom Park. Earn 3 CSFL hours. Bring reusable gloves and water bottles. Sign up at OSA.
title: Eco Warriors: Coastal Cleanup

content: The University Health Service now offers free mental health consultations every Thursday. Schedule appointments via UHS Telegram channel (@UPCEBUWellness).
title: Mental Health Check-in Sessions

content: Intramurals 2025 registration starts July 1. Events include beach volleyball, esports, and traditional Cebuano games. Team captains must attend the briefing on July 5.
title: Palarong UP Cebu 2025

content: Extended library hours during midterms (July 7-18): Open until 10 PM. Silent study zones enforced. Present student ID for after-hours access.
title: Midterm Week Library Hours

content: Campus shuttle routes will change effective July 15 due to road repairs. New pickup points: Behind CAS Building and near Gymnasium. See updated map at Admin Office.
title: Shuttle Service Route Adjustment

content: Submit proposals for the Student Research Grant (maximum ₱15,000 funding) by July 30. Priority given to climate action and digital heritage projects. Guidelines at OVCAA.
title: Undergraduate Research Funding
